podcast.body: The song "Breed," from Nirvana's *Nevermind* album, was originally titled "Imotium." Kurt Cobain was inspired to write it after observing Tad Doyle, singer of the band Tad, using the over-the-counter anti-diarrhea medication Imodium during a 1989 tour due to his own stomach problems, which Kurt also suffered from. The title was later changed to "Breed" to avoid potential legal issues. "Kurt was impressed enough to write a song called emotium, about when it came time to record the Nevermind album, the title was changed to breed, just in case any lawyer's got to say."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
